summary: Nugvio MVP smoke test on preview URL. Backend auth, health-score, nudges, categorize (Zomato->Food), expenses CRUD, budgets, budget-alerts, goals with NugPoints (+5 pts confirmed on ₹500 contribute), debts, debt strategy avalanche, coach chat (Gemini reply received) + history, lessons list, cashflow forecast, rewards, and all recurring endpoints (list/add/patch/post/run-due/delete) tested successfully. Frontend: login with prefilled demo creds redirects to /app dashboard rendering FHS 69, nudge banner, 855 NugPoints, cashflow chart, recent expenses. alerts-bell visible + panel opens. /app/recurring shows stats + seeded list; add form successfully added 'UI Test Sub' row. recurring-run-all clicked without error. /app/budgets renders form + budget cards.
passed: POST /api/auth/login demo user returns 200 with token
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user
GET /api/budgets returns budgets with spent populated
GET /api/budget-alerts returns {alerts, count, critical} (empty since seeded usage <60%)
GET /api/debts + /debts/strategy?method=avalanche returns months=41, total_interest, order, schedule
POST /api/coach/chat returns Gemini reply; /coach/history persists messages
POST /api/recurring creates; PATCH pauses; POST /post creates expense + advances next_due; POST /run-due returns {posted:N}; DELETE removes
alerts-bell visible on authenticated pages; alerts-panel opens on click
/app/recurring add flow: rec-name/rec-amount/rec-submit successfully added row

failed.area: Test spec vs API schema (informational, NOT a bug)
failed.issue: Review spec mentioned POST /api/lessons/complete with only lesson_id and POST /api/tax/estimate with gross_income; actual API requires 'score' for lessons and 'annual_income' for tax. Endpoints work correctly with proper payload.
budget-alerts-inline count=0 on /app/budgets — expected since seeded budget usage is below 60% threshold so alerts array is empty. Not a defect.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: to visually verify inline budget alerts UI, seed a budget where spent>=60% of monthly_limit, or reduce Entertainment monthly_limit so ₹99/₹1500 exceeds threshold.
